summary_markdown: The conversation centered on reviewing the 'Ramboll: Integrate data from Ramboll API (Demographic data)' task. The front end for all demographic categories is not yet complete, but current functionality allows viewing gender and age demographics under `juno.koro` in the dashboard and campaign view. Future capabilities will include vehicle and purpose, as well as income and education (though these fields currently return empty). Someone confirmed that they would approve the task now but plan to follow up later regarding the source of specific data figures.
decisions: The 'Ramboll: Integrate data from Ramboll API (Demographic data)' task will be approved.
action_items: Someone needs to explain the origin of specific demographic data figures to [p1] at a later date.
